What it costs

Packages from £1,800 a month.

Every package runs on the same 14-day sprint. Month to month, with a one-month minimum. Ad spend is separate.

Every package includes

  • A brief and script for every batch
  • 8 hooks written for every script, ready to test
  • Creators cast from our roster, shortlist approved by you
  • A directed shoot for every picked hook
  • A hook cut and a full edit of every video
  • One revision round per video
  • Organic and paid usage rights for the term, in writing

  • Starter

    From £1,800 a month

    6 videos a month

    • 1 creative brief a month

    Best for Brands testing UGC for the first time

  • Growth

    From £3,600 a month

    12 videos a month

    • 2 creative briefs a month
    • Whitelisting and Spark Ads setup

    Best for Brands scaling paid social and testing formats fast

  • Scale

    From £6,500 a month

    24 or more videos a month

    • Weekly briefs
    • Whitelisting and Spark Ads setup

Right for you if

  • You sell a product or app people can show on a phone.
  • You want new ads every month, not a one-off shoot.
  • You'd rather approve scripts and shortlists than manage creators.

Probably not for you if

  • You need a single video, once. A creator marketplace will usually be quicker and cheaper.
  • You want someone to run your ad spend. We set up whitelisting and Spark Ads; the spend stays with you.
  • You need finished ads this week. First cuts take 14 days from a signed brief.

Not in any package: your ad spend, the product itself, and usage beyond your package term, which we price up front if you want it.

‘From’ is honest: we scope the final number on the call, once we know how many videos you need and how long you want the rights for.

Rights and safety

The paperwork is part of the job.

Four things we do on every sprint, so your brand, your creators and your ad account are covered before anyone presses record.

How we handle rights →

  • Usage rights in writing

    Organic and paid usage for the term of your package, written into the contract, not implied in a DM.

  • Signed creator releases

    Every creator signs a release before filming, covering the footage, usage window and whitelisting, so the rights are clean.

  • ASA and CAP disclosure

    Paid partnerships are labelled and every ad follows the CAP Code the ASA enforces. Our practice, not a certification.

  • UK GDPR data handling

    Creator and client data handled under UK GDPR, as our privacy policy sets out. Our pages set no cookies and run no analytics; the cal.com calendar on the booking page sets its own.

Before you book

Questions brands ask first.

Short answers. Anything else, ask on the call.

Book a call with Avi All questions
↳What does it cost?

Packages start at £1,800 a month for six videos (Starter). Growth is from £3,600 for twelve, and Scale from £6,500 for twenty-four or more. Ad spend and the product itself are separate, and we scope the final number on the call.

↳How fast do we get videos?

Your first cuts arrive 14 days after you sign the brief, with casting, the shoot and the edit inside that. The date is written into the contract, and your revision round follows.

↳What do we have to do?

Sign off the brief and script, pick the hooks with us, approve the creator shortlist, send product (or a login, for an app) and give one round of notes on the cuts. We do the rest.

↳Who owns the videos, and can we run them as ads?

You get the right to run them, organic and paid, for the usage window in your package, written into the contract. Every creator signs a release before filming, and longer windows are priced up front. Growth and Scale include whitelisting and Spark Ads setup.

↳You're new. Why should we trust you?

We are new, and we'd rather say so than invent a client list. What you can check instead: the example ads on this page, the 14-day sprint above, and three terms written into every contract: first cuts 14 days after a signed brief, eight hooks written for every script, and one contract and one invoice. Nothing is filmed until you've approved the script and the creators, and packages run month to month with a one-month minimum.

↳How many revisions do we get?

One full revision round per video, in every package. The script is locked before anyone films, so most rounds go on pacing or captions rather than reshoots.

↳What if the first videos don't work?

Every video gets a revision round, and the next brief is written from what the first cuts showed, so the work gets more specific rather than starting again. Packages run month to month with a one-month minimum, so you're never locked into a long contract.

↳Do you run our ads?

No. On Growth and Scale we set up whitelisting and Spark Ads, and we tell you which cuts to run where. Your ad spend and your ad account stay with you.

↳What happens on the call?

Thirty minutes on Google Meet with Avi. Bring your product and two or three ads you like, yours or anyone's. You'll leave knowing whether UGC suits your launch, which formats we'd test first and why, and what your first month would cost. If another route suits you better, we'll say so.
